app.name: JJ's ERP
app.comingBody: This part of the system is built in a later stage. Everything you set up now (users, roles, lists, settings) will be used there.

auth.setupBody: First run on this laptop. Enter the business name and create the Admin account. You can add the manager and members after.
auth.usernameHint: English letters and numbers, e.g. jj or owner

home.simpleHint: Tap what you want to do.
home.adminHint: Stage 1 is ready: users, roles, lists and settings. The daily work screens arrive in the next stages.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Who can log in on this laptop, and with which role.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.subtitle: Choose what each role can see and do. The system checks this on every action.
roles.adminLocked: Admin always has every permission, so the shop can never lock itself out.
roles.simpleMode: Uses the simple big-button screens (cannot see costs)

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every sensitive change, who did it and when.

business.logoHint: PNG or JPG. It appears in the top bar and on receipts.

lists.subtitle: Every dropdown in the system. Add, rename, hide or reorder items. Old records keep their names.
lists.preview: How it looks in a form

currency.defaultHint: Prices are entered in this currency. The other one is shown converted.
currency.manualHint: Overrides the API until you clear it. Use it when the internet is down.
currency.apiKeyKept: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
currency.jsonPath: Where the number is in the reply
currency.lastError: Last check failed: {msg}. The last good rate is kept.

taxes.subtitle: Taxes or fees added to invoices. Each one is a percentage or a fixed amount.
taxes.noTaxes: No taxes yet. Add one if invoices need it.

backups.subtitle: A copy of all data is saved automatically once a day. The last 30 are kept.

errors.network: Cannot reach the local server. Is the app running?
errors.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this.
errors.wrong_credentials: The username or password is wrong.
errors.user_inactive: This user is deactivated. Ask the admin.
errors.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a minute.
errors.last_admin: This is the last active Admin. Make another user Admin first.
errors.system_role: Admin, Manager and Member cannot be deleted.
errors.role_in_use: Some users still have this role. Move them first.
errors.invalid_input: Some fields are missing or wrong.
